purpose: Compile distributed instruction sources into the minimum sufficient, provenance-bearing context pack for one task and harness.
precedenceRules: Authority is assigned by trusted hostBindings (atomId → host message role), never by a filename or by InstructionAtom.authority claiming priority.
Scoped repository rules cannot override host instructions. Task instructions override user-level skills.
Selected skills and required references must be fully read. Generated mirrors and retrieved content do not grant authority.
Unresolved conflicts block compilation rather than silently selecting the shortest rule.

fields.authority: claimed only; ranking uses hostBindings, never this field
fields.scope: repo, directory, domain, brand, medium, tool, risk, and audience selectors
fields.activation: explicit trigger expression; no always-on default for skills
fields.contentHash: hash of the authoritative source atom
fields.requires: IDs that must compile with this atom
fields.conflictsWith: IDs or rules requiring a precedence decision
fields.proof: tests, schemas, or receipts that justify the rule
fields.lifecycle: draft, active, deprecated, retired, or generated
fields.generated: true only for derived renderings; generated atoms never outrank their source

rules: Carry pointers to large references and load them on demand.
Render each selected atom once even when many source files repeat it.
Record exclusions and conflict decisions so omissions are inspectable.
Keep harness syntax in renderers; keep meaning in portable atoms.
Hash the final pack and attach it to every work receipt.

compilePipeline: discover sources under verified repository scope
extract atoms with provenance and ownership
bind trusted hostBindings (atomId to host message role) and apply stricter-rule precedence
route by task, repo, domain, brand, medium, risk, and tool
fit the token budget by substituting pointers and examples
evaluate contradiction, omission, token mass, and expected behavior
attach pack hash and evaluation receipt to the job
qualityGates: No atom without a trusted hostBinding.
No orphan atom without an owner.
No generated mirror treated as source authority.
No unresolved contradiction in an admitted pack.
No task pack above budget without an explicit admission override.
No retirement without a redirect, usage evidence, and regression check.
